reason: 该插件的核心用途是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的循环变更审阅：在每个 agent loop 结束时自动记录工作区变更，并以气泡与右侧面板展示可回看 diff，核心能力包括按轮次查看与回退（整轮或单文件）。

summaries.zh: 该插件用于 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的 agent 循环变更审阅，在每轮结束后记录并展示文件级差异，并支持一键回退整轮或单文件修改。
summaries.en: This plugin adds agent-loop change review in DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, recording workspace diffs at loop end and showing them for review, with one-click revert for the whole loop or selected files.

capabilities: Captures workspace snapshots at agent-loop boundaries and computes file diffs.
Displays per-loop, per-file diff review in chat-linked bubble and right-side panel.
Exposes local routes for loop metadata, unified diff retrieval, and revert operations.
Can restore files to pre-loop content (full loop or single-file revert).

reasons.code: README 说明插件在 agent running→idle 周期后重新扫描并检测变更，生成并持久化 loop 记录（含行级 diff）。
README 说明客户端提供侧边栏“变更审阅”标签页与会话区域气泡入口，并支持逐文件内联 diff 与一键撤销。
README 公开路由包括 /dsh-build-diff/loops、/loop/<id>、/loop/<id>/revert，对应查看与回滚能力。
README 的限制说明对同一文件多轮改动时回滚旧 loop 可能覆盖后续改动，表明存在可逆但有覆盖语义的文件写入风险。
